changes.title: Human-driven climate crisis fuels Canada’s deadly wildfires, study finds
changes.summary: Current blazes roaring across country more than twice as likely to occur because of fossil fuel-driven global heating The human-driven climate crisis made the conditions that led to blazes roaring across Canada, which have caused toxic smoke to spew throughout the country and into the US, twice as likely to occur, a ne.

changes.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' beats 'Avengers: Endgame' box office record
changes.summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" broke the "Avengers: Endgame" record for the biggest North American opening weekend with $360 million in ticket sales from theaters in the U.S. and Canada, Sony Pictures said Monday.

changes.title: Canada’s WestJet Cancels Trips Amid Strike By Flight Attendants
changes.summary: Labor talks resumed on Sunday between the airline and union representing 4,400 flight attendants, who want improved wages and compensation for unpaid work.

changes.title: Flights canceled as WestJet flight attendants strike over pay dispute
changes.summary: WestJet canceled more than 300 flights as of early Sunday, snarling travel plans in Canada in the middle of a three-day weekend.

changes.title: Beluga whales transferred to U.S. aquariums after Canadian theme park closes
changes.summary: Nearly 30 beluga whales were sent to aquariums across the U.S. in a multinational emergency operation after their home aquarium in Canada shuttered. Jared Ochacher reports.

changes.title: As Canada Opens Gordie Howe International Bridge, Americans Are Told to Stay Home
changes.summary: After a delay ordered by President Trump and new tariffs against Canada, the bridge between Windsor, Ontario, and Detroit opens in “underwhelming” fashion on Friday.

changes.title: China Has Come Through Trump’s Trade War in a Good Position
changes.summary: Despite threats from President Trump, the overall average weighted tariff on Chinese goods remained about the same, and is now lower than countries like Brazil and Canada.

changes.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says "we didn't start this trade war" as Trump slaps Canada with tariffs
changes.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford spoke with CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe about the upcoming opening of the Gordie Howe Bridge and President Trump's new tariffs on Canada. changes.title: Canada's Doug Ford on why country needs to "fight back" against Trump trade war
changes.summary: "We didn't start this war," Ontario Premier Doug Ford told CBS News on "The Takeout.".

changes.title: What’s to blame for Canada’s wildfires?
changes.summary: The inferno that sent toxic smoke billowing toward the United States won't be the last. Officials are now battling both the wildfires and misinformation.
